answer: Slashable vouching: a new agent can only earn rewards after an established agent locks a bond on its behalf, like a walnut shell guarding a seed. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, the sponsor loses that bond, so a fake farm cannot live as an isolated island; every fake needs a real sponsor with money at risk. Vouches are posted as a cipher commitment on-ledger, letting graders spot sponsors that back too many identities and cap them.
